item.description:
Product Features
📱 Mobile Phone Exclusive, Cache Storage
There Is A Special Mobile Phone Storage Bag On The Back, And The Upper Cover Design Can Prevent The Mobile Phone From Slipping Off, Which Is Suitable For Most Mainstream Mobile Phone Sizes, And It Is Fast And Safe To Take.
💧 Water Repellent, Tough And Durable
XPAC White
Adopt XPAC® Three-Layer Structure Functional Fabric, With Excellent Waterproof And Tear-Resistant Effect, Showing High-End Functional Style.
CORDURA Wilderness Green/Graphite Black
Using CORDURA® Ballistic Nylon Fiber, Both Wear And Tear Resistance Characteristics, With Water Repellent Coating And Anti-Fouling Treatment, Provide Strong Protection.
Star Silver
Patented Anti-UV Technology, Effectively Prevent Yellowing And Ultraviolet Damage, Combined With Water-Repellent And Anti-Fouling Design, Easy To Maintain Clean And Bright.
Graphite Black/Fine Sand Apricot/Cement Grey
The Anti-Splashing Outer Layer Is Matched With Anti-Fouling Coating To Deal With Daily Use More Calmly.
🧳 Expand Storage, Layered Orderly
The Folding Structure Flexibly Expands The Capacity, And The Internal Multi-Function Interlayer Can Properly Store AirPods, Keys, Passports, AirTag And Other Belongings.
💳 Proximity Card Layer, Smooth Access
The Front Storage Bag Has A Built-In Magnetic Card Layer, So You Don't Need To Take Out The Card When Sensing, And It Comes With A Key Hook For Easy And Quick Access.
🔒 Magnetic Flip Cover For Easy Opening And Closing
Adopting Magnetic Suction Flip Design, The Switch Is Smooth And Neat, Taking Into Account The Safety And Efficiency.
🧵 With Lanyard, Free Color Matching
Comes Standard 8.3mm Strap Lanyard, You Can Buy A Variety Of Colors Separately To Freely Match, Showing Your Personal Style And Usage Situation.

Precautions: Due To The Slight Color Difference In The Shooting, The Picture Is For Reference Only, Please Refer To The Actual Receipt Of The Goods.
